summary: Backend regression on Conactivos HR after birthday-fix, dynamic-seed and web-showAlert changes. 27/27 pytest tests PASS covering: (1) POST /api/seed idempotency + counts (3 admins, 10 employees, 3 leaves, 3 events, 3 capsules, 6 kudos). (2) /api/dashboard/birthdays returns dict with 'today' + 'upcoming'; Juan Pérez in today; Laura (3d), Pedro (8d), Sofía (15d), Miguel (22d) in upcoming with days_until > 0 (previously broken - returned 0); list is sorted by days_until. (3) /api/dashboard/absent returns Pedro Sánchez with type='medical'. (4) /api/goals returns current month 65% ($325K/$500K). (5) /api/dashboard/employee-of-month returns Juan Pérez, _id serialized as string, no password leak. (6) Auth: admin login (admin1@conactivos.com/admin123) + employee login (juan.perez@conactivos.com/employee123), /auth/me, wrong-password 401. (7) Leave create → admin approve → employee sees 'approved' flow works; employee cannot approve (403). (8) Kudos create by employee to another employee works, self-kudo returns 400. (9) Admin-only guards: employees get 403 on /api/reports/stats, POST /api/events, PUT /api/goals/{id}; admins get 200. (10) Unauth request to /api/reports/stats returns 401/403. Frontend smoke on 390x844: login works, home dashboard renders correctly (EMPLEADO DEL MES=Juan Pérez, Ausentes=1, Cumpleaños=5 with '1 hoy', Meta 65%, Cápsula del día visible). All three header buttons (testID: reports-btn / employees-btn / profile-btn) are visible, tappable, and navigate to /reportes, /empleados, /perfil respectively - previously reported 'unresponsive header buttons' issue is resolved.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Image: style.tintColor is deprecated. Please use props.tintColor.' Migrate tintColor from StyleSheet to props. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx & /app/frontend/app/login.tsx (logo).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - likely from library or SafeAreaView usage. Non-blocking.
Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Expected on web; consider guarding useNativeDriver with Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence.

action_items: No functional bugs. All bug fixes validated. Only cosmetic RN deprecation warnings remain (tintColor, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver-on-web) - low priority.
(Optional) Migrate Image tintColor to props.tintColor in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx and /app/frontend/app/login.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/dashboard/birthdays correctly uses date arithmetic (datetime.utcnow().date() and this_year_birthday - today_date).days) - fix is correct. Handles Feb 29 fallback for leap years.

Seed function is idempotent: clears users/leave_requests/events/commercial_goals/capsules/notifications/kudos before insert. Dynamic birthdays via _bday(year, days_offset) ensure fresh dashboard data.
POST /api/seed has no auth guard - anyone can wipe and reseed the database. Consider protecting with admin auth or removing from production; acceptable for dev/demo.
server.py is 1393 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold in the guideline. Consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, users, leaves, dashboard, kudos, etc.) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed once at test-session start. Test class TestKudos created 1 additional kudo (TEST_kudo) and TestLeaveFlow created 1 leave request (TEST_leave_flow); TestAdminGuards created 1 event (TEST_event_admin). These are prefixed 'TEST_' but not cleaned up - a subsequent POST /api/seed will wipe them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary bug fixes validated. If re-testing, call POST /api/seed once at the start to reset state. Admin login: admin1@conactivos.com/admin123; Employee: juan.perez@conactivos.com/employee123. Juan Pérez birthday is dynamically set to TODAY. Pedro Sánchez has approved medical leave for TODAY. Frontend header buttons on Home use testIDs: reports-btn (admin-only), employees-btn, profile-btn.
rca_of_issue: Previous birthdays bug: get_birthdays used datetime.utcnow() (with time component) minus a date at midnight, causing days_until=0 for tomorrow's birthdays and excluding them from 0<days<=30 filter. Fix: switched to date-only arithmetic (today_date = datetime.utcnow().date() and this_year_birthday.date() difference). Verified via test_birthdays_upcoming_days_positive: Laura Gómez (seeded 3 days out) is now returned with days_until=3.
